observations: The first login failed with World server is down. Both server processes/listeners remained healthy. The socket received zero initializer bytes, hit its10-second deadline and the session aborted after five attempts. This occurred before character/scenario loading.

After restarting the client, login succeeded at10:53:03, but the user reported Orgrimmar again. Client.log confirms the exact map1630 -> map1 transition immediately after self creation. Database map1630 alone was stale and did not prove the live location.

The standalone build's game.lib contained the new recovery message, but the delivered worldserver.exe did not. Generated worldserver.vcxproj uses an explicit relative src/server/game/Release/game.lib dependency; globally overriding OutDir wrote the new library elsewhere without updating that final-link dependency. The linker silently used the older library.

The original startup/port smoke check therefore proved availability only. It did not prove that the executable included the implementation. This deployment mistake is separate from the intermittent socket initialization failure.
